title: What this preview is—and isn’t.
heading: What this preview
is—and isn’t.
description: A factual note about the current RideNow website and app-development preview.
lede: An evergreen product note about the RideNow website and apps as they are currently being developed.

sections.title: What you can explore
sections.text: The website presents concept designs for the Rider and Driver apps, explains the intended cash-first approach in Sri Lankan rupees, and describes the product principles being considered. Interactive app-store controls are previews only.

sections.title: What is not available
sections.text: The site does not accept ride requests, create accounts, or take payments. There are no public app-store listings, announced service locations, or published fare rates. SMS verification, live maps, dispatch, route search, payments, and Driver registration are not connected to this website.

sections.title: What happens next
sections.text: RideNow will publish confirmed product and availability information here when it is ready. No launch date or service coverage is being announced in this note.
